Product Details: Introducing the XTRA-POWER Hammer Drill Bit, a robust drilling solution designed for demanding construction tasks. Each pack contains 10 units of these precision-engineered bits, ensuring you have plenty of replacements for your projects. The spiral flute design facilitates efficient debris removal while drilling, reducing heat build-up and extending the bit's lifespan. The bit's dimensions (110mm length with 50mm effective drilling depth) are optimised for both professional contractors and DIY enthusiasts. The durable construction and precise manufacturing ensure consistent performance in challenging drilling conditions. Perfect for installing anchors, mounting fixtures, or general construction work where precise holes are required.
